slides.title:
The neighborhood is gone.
The shop isn't.
slides.body:
Most of Jongno's old Pimatgol alley was demolished in the 2000s redevelopment. For people who remember it, Cheongildip is the closest thing left — a piece of a vanished neighborhood, still frying the same recipe four generations later.

The address changed. The technique didn't.

caption:
When Seoul's old Pimatgol alley was redeveloped, one pancake shop from it moved across the city and kept going — now run by the 4th generation.

Cheongildip · opened 1945 · now at Yeonseo Market (per Seoul Institute for Urban Data archive)
